subject: Russia’s financial watchdog proposes freezing bank accounts over partial matches with ‘terrorists and extremists’ list
posts:
Financial watchdog in Russia proposes freezing accounts on partial matches to extremist lists.
Evidence: administrative pretext, collateral damage, state control
#Aletheia #Russia

Moscow claims new banking rules will stop extremists from dodging financial restrictions by altering their personal information slightly.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

In practice, this creates a dragnet for arbitrary asset freezes, weaponizing bureaucratic name-matching against dissenters without due process.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.9, -0.8) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
State security pretexts mask the expansion of unchecked financial control over citizens.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 12.5, z: 4)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Rosfinmonitoring: FAIL (-0.9, -0.8) — Weaponizes administrative lists.
- Financial Sector: COND (-0.5, -0.5) — Forced compliance.
Russia’s financial monitoring agency drafted rules allowing banks to halt transactions on partial name matches with extremist registries.

The Bright Side:
Bureaucratic dragnet makes state overreach so blatant that citizens easily recognize the absence of legal protections.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confuses administrative procedure (HOW) with fundamental human rights (WHO), weaponizing paperwork for political control.

Social Physics Analysis:
Rosfinmonitoring runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver: inventing compliance crises to justify sweeping financial surveillance and eliminate dissent.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil (u=-0.9, psi=-0.8) via coercive power expansion.

The Unavoidable Truth: Vague matching rules give the state unchecked power to freeze any citizen's funds.

The Unavoidable Lie: This is merely a technical fix to catch real extremists.

Alethekanon:
Bureaucratic ambiguity is never neutral; when paired with broad definitions of extremism, it becomes an instrument of total financial exclusion.

Awwthekanon:
It is heartbreaking to watch ordinary people live in constant fear that a clerical error or common surname could instantly erase their livelihood.

Brothekanon:
Imagine getting your bank card declined because some guy three towns over has a vaguely similar name. Total Kafkaesque nightmare.

Spirithekanon:
"Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, who write misfortune, which they have prescribed." Isaiah 10:1 FAIL
Law is perverted into a snare when vague bureaucratic standards replace justice to punish the vulnerable.

Actual Article Body:
Russia’s Federal Financial Monitoring Service, known as Rosfinmonitoring, is proposing to expand the grounds for freezing bank accounts. Under the proposed amendments, banks would be able to halt transactions when a client’s data only partially matches the data of a person whose funds are subject to a freeze.

The amendments to Russia’s law on combating the legalization of criminally obtained income were published on the government’s portal for draft regulations. The outlet Frank Media drew attention to the document.
